<issue>
generate_token returns tokens one character shorter than requested

#### Description

The `generate_token` function is returning tokens that are one character shorter than the requested length. When calling `generate_token(length=30)`, it returns a 29-character token instead of 30.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from oauthlib.common import generate_token

# This should return a 30-character token but returns 29
token = generate_token(length=30)
print(f"Expected length: 30, Actual length: {len(token)}")

# Same issue with custom length
token = generate_token(length=44)
print(f"Expected length: 44, Actual length: {len(token)}")

# And with custom characters
token = generate_token(length=6, chars='python')
print(f"Expected length: 6, Actual length: {len(token)}")
```

This affects other functions that depend on `generate_token` like `generate_client_id` which also returns shorter tokens than expected.
</issue>
